Ident.description: An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

MlText.description: Multilingual text: a neutral string, or an object keyed by canonical BCP 47 tags with non-empty string values (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express that all text is NFC or that the keys are in ascending byte order; the reader rejects both.

WaiverTarget.description:
The target of a waiver (doc 03 §19 `target: Fingerprint | PartSelector`): the finding fingerprint, the MVP
target. A part selector (`{library, item}`, 1.0) stays in `extra`.

finding.description: The finding fingerprint, as 32 lower-case hex digits (FR-CHK-044).

description:
One waiver (doc 03 §19, doc 15 §2.5, rank 61, `waivers.jsonl`; FR-CHK-009).

It is written only by the `HumanOnly` command `check.waive` (WP-S1.16 D7): the author and the date are that
command's parameters, never read from a clock or the operating system. The check engine marks a finding whose
rule and fingerprint match as waived; a waiver that matches nothing is reported (EW-CORE-081), never deleted.

$k.description: The kind name; always the first member.

author.description:
Who waived it: the author's display name as the GUI recorded it (FT-494). `check.waive` always sets it; a
record written while the kind was reserved may lack it and still loads.

date.description: When it was waived. `check.waive` always sets it; a record written while the kind was reserved may lack it.

reason.description: Why the finding is accepted (at least 10 characters, doc 15 §2.5).

rule.description: The rule ID of the waived finding (`EW-CORE-041`).

title: waiver
